name: prAIcing Agent – AI Price Testing for WooCommerce
author: praicing

sections.description:
You set the business goal (Maximize Profit, Sales or Volume) and the guardrails (margin floors, price limits). The prAIcing Agent tests prices with real shoppers, measures what works and keeps improving — Test, Measure, Learn, Optimize, Retest.

  • One-click connection — no API keys to copy.
  • Live 50/50 price tests: half of shoppers see the test price, enforced through cart and checkout.
  • Works with page caching: tested products are served uncached.
  • No duplicate products, so stock stays accurate.
  • Sample-ratio checks stop tests whose traffic split looks wrong.
  • Every change is logged and can be rolled back.

External services

This plugin connects to the prAIcing service (https://praicing.com) to pair your store, fetch running price tests and send anonymous test events (product views, order units and revenue per test arm). No customer personal data is sent. A prAIcing account is required; plans include a free trial.
Terms: https://praicing.com/help — Privacy: https://praicing.com/help
sections.installation:
1. Plugins → Add New, search “prAIcing Agent”, Install and Activate.
  2. Open WooCommerce → prAIcing Agent and click “Connect to prAIcing”.
  3. Approve the connection — you return to WordPress ready to test.
sections.faq:
Is it free?

The plugin is free. The prAIcing service has a free trial, then a paid subscription.

Will shoppers see different prices?

During a test, half of shoppers see the test price, always within your guardrails. Each shopper sees one price consistently.
